006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import java.util.stream.Stream;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.IDataTypeAdapter;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidTypeFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
014import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * The base interface inherited by all Metapath item implementations.
019 */
020public interface IItem extends ICollectionValue {
021  /**
022   * Get the type information for this item.
023   *
024   * @return the type information
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  static IItemType type() {
028    return IItemType.item();
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Get the type information for the item.
033   *
034   * @return the item's type information
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  IItemType getType();
038
039  /**
040   * Get the item's "wrapped" value. This "wrapped" value may be:
041   * <ul>
042   * <li>In the case of an Assembly, a Java object representing the fields and
043   * flags of the assembly.
044   * <li>In the case of a Field with flags, a Java object representing the field
045   * value and flags of the field.
046   * <li>In the case of a Field without flags or a flag, a Java type managed by a
047   * {@link IDataTypeAdapter} or a primitive type provided by the Java standard
048   * library.
049   * </ul>
050   *
051   * @return the value or {@code null} if the item has no available value
052   */
053  Object getValue();
054
055  /**
056   * Determine if the item has an associated value.
057   *
058   * @return {@code true} if the item has a non-{@code null} value or
059   *         {@code false} otherwise
060   */
061  default boolean hasValue() {
062    return getValue() != null;
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  default ISequence<?> toSequence() {
067    return ISequence.of(this);
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Get the atomic value for the item. This may be the same item if the item is
072   * an instance of {@link IAnyAtomicItem}.
073   * <p>
074   * An implementation of
075   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-atomization">item
076   * atomization</a>.
077   *
078   * @return the atomic value or {@code null} if the item has no available value
079   * @throws InvalidTypeFunctionException
080   *           with code
081   *           {@link InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE} if the
082   *           item does not have a typed value
083   */
084  // FIXME: get rid of the possible null result and throw
085  // InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE
086  IAnyAtomicItem toAtomicItem();
087
088  /**
089   * {@inheritDoc}
090   *
091   * @throws InvalidTypeFunctionException
092   *           with code
093   *           {@link InvalidTypeFunctionException#NODE_HAS_NO_TYPED_VALUE} if the
094   *           item does not have a typed value
095   */
096  @Override
097  default Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> atomize() {
098    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.of(this.toAtomicItem()));
099  }
100
101  @SuppressWarnings("null")
102  @Override
103  default Stream<? extends IItem> flatten() {
104    return Stream.of(this);
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * A visitor callback used to visit a variety of Metapath item types.
109   *
110   * @param visitor
111   *          the visitor to call back
112   */
113  void accept(@NonNull IItemVisitor visitor);
114
115  @Override
116  default ISequence<?> contentsAsSequence() {
117    return toSequence();
118  }
119}
